falsifiers.observed_behavior: The runtime registry contains source families whose primary role is shared evidence support rather than an analytical domain, including entity_resolution and provenance_archival.
falsifiers.expected_behavior: The frozen rc1 contract required every mapped source family to map to at least one analytical domain.
falsifiers.proposed_resolution: Permit source_mapping_target_type=CORE_SUPPORT in addition to DOMAIN. CORE_SUPPORT must name a specific shared-kernel capability such as IDENTITY_RESOLUTION or PROVENANCE_ARCHIVAL and must not be treated as an analytical domain or aggregated finding source.

falsifiers.observed_behavior: The runtime registry includes cross-domain contextual/candidate sources that inform later analytical domains but are not themselves domain findings or mere acquisition/provenance utilities.
falsifiers.expected_behavior: V4-A001 CORE_SUPPORT vocabulary lacks a context/candidate capability and would otherwise force these sources into an analytical domain or an inaccurate support class.
falsifiers.proposed_resolution: Extend CORE_SUPPORT with POLICY_CONTEXT and PRE_OFFICIAL_CANDIDATE. These targets may feed downstream domain events only after explicit promotion/binding and cannot be counted as officialized money or domain-certified findings.

falsifiers.observed_behavior: The runtime source denominator contains direct household/beneficiary transfer and benefit flows that are not intergovernmental and do not fit public-finance procurement/corporate domains without semantic distortion.
falsifiers.expected_behavior: Every analytical money source must have a domain whose primary unit and reconciliation semantics match the actual flow.
falsifiers.proposed_resolution: Add SOCIAL_BENEFITS_AND_HOUSEHOLD_TRANSFERS as an analytical domain for direct government-to-household/individual benefit, assistance, subsidy, and entitlement flows. Keep award/authorization/payment/receipt stages distinct.
falsifiers.implemented_resolution: architecture/v4/domain_registry.yaml adds SOCIAL_BENEFITS_AND_HOUSEHOLD_TRANSFERS; mapping matrix routes direct-benefit sources there; tests/architecture/test_v01_source_domain_mapping.py adds regression.
